sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS entry_count FROM mp_entries;
SELECT DISTINCT e.formula FROM mp_entries e JOIN mp_element_ratios r ON e.entry_id = r.entry_id WHERE r.element = 'Ni' ORDER BY e.formula LIMIT 5;

nl_query: 立方晶で最も体積の大きい材料。
sql: SELECT formula FROM mp_entries WHERE crystal_system = 'Cubic' ORDER BY volume DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT e.formula, e.energy_above_hull FROM mp_entries e JOIN mp_element_ratios r ON e.entry_id = r.entry_id WHERE r.element = 'Co' ORDER BY e.energy_above_hull ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mp_entries WHERE chemsys = 'Al-Ni';

nl_query: 結晶系ごとに材料を数えよ。
sql: SELECT crystal_system, COUNT(*) FROM mp_entries GROUP BY crystal_system ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;

nl_query: バンドギャップがある材料の割合（%）。
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE band_gap > 0) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM mp_entries;

nl_query: CoとTiの両方を含む材料の平均energy_above_hull。
sql: SELECT AVG(e.energy_above_hull) FROM mp_entries e JOIN mp_element_ratios r1 ON e.entry_id = r1.entry_id AND r1.element = 'Co' JOIN mp_element_ratios r2 ON e.entry_id = r2.entry_id AND r2.element = 'Ti';
